question: Should the repository authorize the exact dependency graph and protected catalog-refresh workflow carried by this cumulative branch, or require the G47 surface gate to be restacked after its prerequisites land?
rationale: The repository policy blocks external dependency graph changes without an exact-head admin or SecOps decision, and the new workflow has a privileged branch-update boundary that automated patch review cannot approve.

options.title: Authorize, then restack the slice
options.body: Approve the exact dependency change after security review, land the prerequisite stack in order, and require this branch to be rebased to its narrow remaining G47 delta.

options.title: Pause the cumulative branch
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer it until the localization foundation and refresh workflow have separate owner approvals.

recommendation.title: Authorize, then restack the slice
recommendation.body: Approve the exact dependency change after security review, land the prerequisite stack in order, and require this branch to be rebased to its narrow remaining G47 delta.
